name: Employee Work Summary
query:
SELECT
    wtm.employee_id AS "Employee:Link/Employee:150",
    COUNT(DISTINCT ps.name) AS "Total Projects:Int:100",
    ps.status AS "Project Status:Data:100",
    COUNT(DISTINCT eam.date) AS "Total Days:Int:100",
    SUM(eam.duration) AS "Total Hours:Float:100"
FROM
    `tabProject Setup` ps
JOIN
    `tabWork Team` wt ON ps.work_team = wt.name
JOIN
    `tabTeam Members List` wtm ON wt.name = wtm.parent
LEFT JOIN
    `tabEmployee Attendance Master` eam 
    ON eam.employee = wtm.employee_id
    AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR eam.date >= %(from_date)s)
    AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR eam.date <= %(to_date)s)
GROUP BY
    wtm.employee_id, ps.status
ORDER BY
    wtm.employee_id;
